# Count total years where Errea was the kit manufacturer
# First, extract start and end years from the 'Year' column
df[['start_year', 'end_year']] = df['Year'].str.split('–', expand=True)

# Convert to numeric, handling cases where end_year might be empty (ongoing)
df['start_year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['start_year'])
df['end_year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['end_year'], errors='coerce')

# For rows where end_year is NaN (ongoing), use the start_year as end_year
df['end_year'] = df['end_year'].fillna(df['start_year'])

# Filter rows where Kit Manufacturer is Errea
errea_df = df[df['Kit Manufacturer'] == 'Errea'].copy()

# Calculate duration for each Errea period
errea_df['duration'] = errea_df['end_year'] - errea_df['start_year'] + 1

# Sum all durations to get total years
total_years = errea_df['duration'].sum()

answer = int(total_years)
